content:
anya: Repro: sampleapp prefetch window stalls when token refresh happens during paginated prefetch. Steps: prefetchConcurrency=3, token TTL short, tokenRefreshSync=true.

anya: Logs show prefetch workers blocked waiting on auth mutex: 
```
prefetch: fetch(page=2) waiting for token refresh
auth: refresh started
prefetch: waiting on auth mutex
http: queued 401 retries
```

sam: That sounds like the mutex is global and refresh path blocks fetchers. We patched similar in Go months ago.

jing: Which SDK/version?

anya: JS SDK v0.26.1, sampleapp defaults.

tyler: tokenRefreshSync=true is risky with parallel prefetch. If all prefetch slots wait on refresh you can deadlock the pipeline. Workaround: set tokenRefreshSync=false so refresh is async.

anya: Workaround helped but we want a proper fix in SDK and parity across languages.

sam: Proposal: 1) prefetch should use a token snapshot per batch, 2) refresh should run async and not grab global prefetch lock, 3) add prefetchRetryWindowMs config and metric prefetch.auth_retries.

jing: Agree. Also add small jitter to prefetch starts to reduce thundering herd on expiry.

tyler: Quick prototype (JS):
```
const token = auth.getTokenSnapshot();
fetchPage(page, { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` })
auth.refreshIfNeeded().catch(() => {/* retry handled */})
```
tyler: In local tests no deadlock, pages flow. 401 retry rate up from 0.5% to ~1.1% but acceptable if opt-in.

sam: Make it opt-in initially: allowOptimisticPrefetch=false default, add telemetry and changelog note.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for branch "prefetch-optimistic-2026" (deploy id: d-7982).

jing: Please open PR with unit tests simulating mid-window expiry and deterministic clock for jitter. I will review.

anya: I'll update quickstart guidance: recommend tokenRefreshSync=false until SDK parity lands. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
